subject.title: RFC: Period-based popularity for publishers, skills, and plugins

question: Should ClawHub standardize Weekly/Monthly/All time popularity across publishers, skills, and plugins before shipping visible browse tabs?
rationale: Current main only has partial seven-day trending support and package daily stats; the requested cross-surface behavior still requires maintainer choices for scoring, attribution, low-activity handling, snapshot pagination, and rollout/backfill semantics.

options.title: Approve shared foundation first
options.body: Define the cross-surface period semantics and data model, then implement publisher rollups and weekly/monthly leaderboards before adding the tabs.

options.title: Keep existing Trending only
options.body: Leave current skills/plugins Trending in place and defer monthly and publisher alignment until a maintainer sponsors the broader contract.

options.title: Document contract before code
options.body: Capture the intended scoring, attribution, and pagination rules in specs before approving implementation PRs.

recommendation.title: Approve shared foundation first
recommendation.body: Define the cross-surface period semantics and data model, then implement publisher rollups and weekly/monthly leaderboards before adding the tabs.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest current-main history signal for browse, publisher ranking, and leaderboard code points to Patrick-Erichsen.
